nodes.label: CREPE: Open-Domain QA with False Presuppositions
nodes.source_file: Papers/CREPE- Open-Domain Question Answering with False Presuppositions.pdf
nodes.author: Xinyan Velocity Yu; Sewon Min; Luke Zettlemoyer; Hannaneh Hajishirzi

nodes.label: False Presupposition
nodes.source_file: Papers/CREPE- Open-Domain Question Answering with False Presuppositions.pdf
nodes.rationale: A condition assumed but not stated in a question that is false based on global factual knowledge; makes the question infelicitous with no direct answer.

nodes.label: Presupposition Correction
nodes.source_file: Papers/CREPE- Open-Domain Question Answering with False Presuppositions.pdf
nodes.rationale: Following Kaplan (1978), the adequate answer to an infelicitous question is a negated presupposition (corrective indirect response).

nodes.label: ELI5 Reddit Dataset Source
nodes.source_file: Papers/CREPE- Open-Domain Question Answering with False Presuppositions.pdf
nodes.rationale: Natural information-seeking questions collected from the ELI5 subreddit; most-upvoted comments used as credible annotation signal to lower cost.

nodes.label: Detection and Writing Subtasks
nodes.source_file: Papers/CREPE- Open-Domain Question Answering with False Presuppositions.pdf
nodes.rationale: Two subtasks: detect whether a false presupposition exists, and write the presupposition plus correction; models struggle with implicit presuppositions and retrieval.

nodes.label: GOLD-COMMENT Track
nodes.source_file: Papers/CREPE- Open-Domain Question Answering with False Presuppositions.pdf
nodes.rationale: Easier evaluation track where the most-voted comment is given to the model alongside the question, versus the question-only main track.
